## About

Mater Dei Spa is a professional beauty salon located in Tres Valles, Veracruz, Mexico. The spa specializes in facial treatments, relaxation massages, and therapeutic services. It was founded by Teresita de Jesús, a licensed Cosmetologist dedicated to providing high-quality personal care services.

The name "Mater Dei" (Mother of God in Latin) reflects the philosophy of care and dedication towards every client.
